subject: Reg the starting position of genetic map

messages.author: b851f9a8b81a6867
messages.subject: Reg the starting position of genetic map
parts:
Hi Dr Karl

I have a situation where a chromosome was initially severely extended. 

 pull.map(sf261, chr=8)

  CMN5-75  CMCTT144    DM0082    DE1334  SSR15316   CSWCT33    DE1468  CMTCN248 
    2.400  1003.906  1020.092  1050.638  1081.868  1091.157  1111.058  1146.109 
   DE1245    DM0103    BHLH38    DE1358 CMCTTN181    DE1107   CMTCN56 
 1151.113  1158.693  1165.516  1173.581  1183.248  1193.981  1249.667 

I used geno.cross tab and figured that CMN5-75 was indeed a bad marker.

So, I dropped that marker assuming that it will fix the error. However, the genetic map positions of the other markers did not change for some reason.

  pull.map(sf261, chr=8)

 CMCTT144    DM0082    DE1334  SSR15316   CSWCT33    DE1468    DE1245  CMTCN248 
 1003.906  1020.095  1050.647  1081.997  1091.351  1111.563  1148.687  1155.394 
   DM0103    BHLH38    DE1358 CMCTTN181    DE1107   CMTCN56 
 1159.499  1167.586  1175.847  1185.474  1196.203  1251.866 

I am sure there is an easy fix for this issue. Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks
Raghu

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Reg the starting position of genetic map
parts:
You need to run est.map and then replace.map

  newmap <- est.map(sf261)
  sf261 <- replace.map(sf261, newmap)

karl
